risk: Silent message termination on unhandled routing exceptions
consequence: Messages that do not meet Glovia_Route_SalesOrder or Glovia_Route2_ReturnSalesOrder land on Escalation End (EndEvent_11) with ErrorCode 'RoutingConditionNotMet'. If sender does not handle SOAP Faults, sales orders are lost without notice.
mitigation: Suite validates TC_ROUTER_DEFAULT_ESCALATION_03 asserting SOAP Fault return with 'RoutingConditionNotMet' error code; monitoring alarms must track Escalated message instances in CPI.

risk: Property loss on exception subprocess body overwrite
consequence: If CallActivity_97 attempts to restore InputPayload when the property was never initialized (e.g. failure at CallActivity_4), the message payload becomes empty null string in Log_Payload.gsh.
mitigation: Set Message headers (CallActivity_4) is verified as the immediate step after MessageStartEvent to guarantee property 'InputPayload' instantiation before routing or mapping.

risk: Dangling unlinked flow components in iFlow bundle
consequence: CallActivity_86 (Content Modifier extracting OrganizationId) and CallActivity_77 (GLOVIA_Conditioncheck_Salesorder_Create.groovy) are defined in definitions but detached from sequence flows, creating architectural ambiguity and dead code.
mitigation: Test suite asserts routing logic based on router expressions; coverage analysis documents dead-code fragments for refactoring/removal.
